prose: Mike Wilkerson of Stellium7 on YouTube joins InnerVerse to discuss his research on Bio-Geology and the ways in which organic material becomes petrified. Is the earth below our feet made from the remains of ancient mega-fauna? What does the mainstream say about the possibility that aside from igneous stone, all rock was once alive? We discuss all of this and more, including theories about the shrinking of life forms over eons, ubiquitous fractal patterns, & sonoluminescence.
ext: We talk about the infamous Montgo titanic elephant, more fascinating petrification possibilities, histology of geological materials, biological transmutations unrecognized by "the science," unanswered questions about Mike's Titan, the evidence for super-massive petrified trees, heart-stones, research synchronicities, and the panpsychism of stone.
